descriptions.w3d_d29g_sheep_input_message_80070b64: Super sheep message handler: starts on message 64 after the base handler succeeds, cancels on 66; otherwise it matches the id against twelve cached ids in press and release pairs for six movement directions, setting a direction and clearing its opposite on press, clearing it on release and stamping the idle time at +352 once all six are clear; unknown ids go to the base handler.
